retrievalProfile.description: A central portrait framed by organic, psychedelic filigree against a surreal cloudscape, featuring arched sans-serif display type.
triggerTerms: wicker chair portrait with sky background
excludeWhen: flat vector illustrations without photographic elements

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure seated in a white wicker rocking chair, floating against a blue sky with soft white clouds. The composition is framed by two large, symmetrical, pink organic-shaped filigree elements that resemble melting or psychedelic scrollwork. Bold, arched typography sits above the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject anchored by a white wicker chair
Symmetrical pink filigree framing the left and right edges
Arched text following the curve of the subject's head
Surreal sky background providing a dreamlike atmosphere
coreInvariants: Blue sky with horizontal cloud streaks
Arched sans-serif display typography with white outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-full shot, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white wicker rocking chair provides a solid structural base for the floating composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the arched title, move down to the subject's face, and are contained by the pink side borders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky background acts as negative space, creating a sense of lightness and elevation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and white (background and subject clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key values with saturated pink and red accents against a pastel background.

letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline for the primary title
Thin white outline on saturated fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly compressed horizontally to fit the arch
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text is a smaller, flat version of the primary sans-serif in a contrasting red color.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the arch.
Classic sans-serif with high legibility and period-appropriate feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal scene of a person in a white wicker rocking chair floating in a blue sky with soft clouds, framed by pink psychedelic organic filigree on the left and right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched bold sans-serif text in pink with a white outline above the subject's head, and smaller red sans-serif text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Are the pink borders organic and symmetrical?
Is the background a clear sky with clouds?

adjustableVariables: Subject pose in the wicker chair
postGenerationChecks: Check for white outline on primary text
Ensure filigree does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the wicker texture is visible
Confirm the sky background is bright and airy
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + wicker chair + sky background + pink psychedelic borders + arched bold sans-serif text.
